name: print-social-cake-filling-picker-in-app-style-cards
title: Filling picker post with search bar and four gradient cards with corner number bubbles
whatItIs: A pale grey post with a lime search bar 'choose a fillings' at the top and four rounded gradient cards (pink, green, caramel, chocolate) each with a cut-out ingredient overlapping the top-left, an italic-and-bold label, and a cream circle number notched into the bottom-right corner. A small blue brand name sits at the bottom.
whatItMeans: Tasty and easy to scan; the interface look makes choosing feel like using an app.
techniques: Colour each card to match its ingredient.
Overlap the cutout product outside the card edge.
Notch a number circle into the card corner.
Mix light italic and bold in one label.

vocabulary.definition: A card corner cut away to hold a badge.
A pill imitating a search field as a title.
Card colour drawn from the product.
